title: Alone
description:
S13 E04 — Cold Omen
The survivalists grow comfortable in their surroundings, until the mountains signal a harsh shift ahead; as winter encroaches, one faces a dangerous predator encounter, while another begins to crack under the pressure.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E05 — Thin Margins
As the survivalists find a brief window to regroup and refocus, the Arctic continues to test their resolve; one participant gets their chance at big game, while another faces a lynx who puts their food supply at risk.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E06 — Balancing Act
With survival hinging on preparation, the remaining participants scramble to secure the essentials; key food wins offer a glimmer of hope, but mounting fatigue and a looming medical check threaten to unravel hard-earned progress.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E07 — Natural Order
Wildlife encounters push the participants to their limits as one faces a run-in with a moose and another is stalked by a bear; the environment continues to test both body and mind, forcing the competitors to confront external and internal threats.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E08 — Tides of Fortune
As turbulent weather continues to batter the survivalists, one participant takes to the open water and another successfully finds a goldmine of food in an unlikely source.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E09 — Icebound
As the temperature plummets, the river begins to lock up; shelter designs are put to the ultimate test, leaving one survivalist struggling to stay warm; smoke causes another to question their longevity.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E10 — No Safe Haven
As brutal cold and snow pummel the Arctic, one survivalist makes a grave mistake with a key piece of gear.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E11 — Fire and Famine
As the Arctic winter deepens, a mistake leaves one survivalist racing to save their shelter from going up in smoke; a bear raid on a critical food source leaves another participant reeling.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E12 — Subzero
As the Arctic cold pushes the final three survivalists to the brink, a series of critical medical checks threatens to end their journeys just short of the finish line.

title: Alone
description:
S13 E13 — Worlds Apart
As the Arctic plunges into near-total darkness, the final survivalists must summon every ounce of mental resilience to endure the crushing isolation of the brutal, approaching polar night.

title: 9/11: The Legacy
description: More than 72 million children woke up the morning of Sept. 11, 2001, to what seemed like an ordinary Tuesday; in the end, eight lost their lives and more than 3,000 lost their parents.

title: 9/11: The Pentagon
description: The story of what happened inside the Pentagon in the minutes after a hijacked airliner crashed into the building as part of the largest coordinated terror attack on American soil, as told by the men and women who lived it.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1: Brooklyn Jihad (1990-1995)
While investigating the assassination of a rabbi in 1990, agents discover a Brooklyn-based terrorist cell with connections to Osama bin Laden; in 1993, cell members succeed in setting off a bomb in the World Trade Center, killing six people.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2: The Bin Ladens (1995-2000)
Clinton administration officials react to the rise in jihadi terror; operations are planned targeting Osama bin Laden resulting in near misses; a profile of bin Laden emerges through interview footage with him and commentary from people who knew him.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3: The Days of Terror (2000-2003)
A portrait of Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the mastermind of the Sept. 11 attacks; a look at the men recruited to carry out the attacks, including their backgrounds and training; an examination of missed signals in Washington, D.C., prior to the attacks.

title: Days That Shaped America: September 11th
description: The largest terror attack in United States history left images seared into everyone's conscience that will never be forgotten; for those caught in the middle, the memories are as strong today as they were in 2001.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E19 — The Hunt for the Anthrax Killer
Deadly anthrax spores sent through the mail kill five people and spread authorities thin; the FBI works around the clock to stop this brazen act of bioterrorism, but the letters keep coming.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E20 — The Hunt for Osama bin Laden: Case Closed
On Sept. 11, 2001, an act of terror changes America; Mastermind Osama bin Laden threatens further attacks; a global manhunt begins; almost a decade later, U.S. Navy SEALs raid a compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan and kill him.

title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
The history of the SEALs' predecessors in World War II and the Korean War and their evolution into elite warriors, fighting in the jungles of Vietnam and executing secret missions in Panama and Grenada; the formation of SEAL Team 6.

title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
The SEALs become the tip of the spear in the War on Terror, executing daily raids in Afghanistan and Iraq as well as high-profile missions, such as the rescue of Capt. Richard Phillips from pirates and the raid on Osama bin Laden's compound.

Frustrated by the limitations of personal transportation, rival engineers Carl Benz and Gottlieb Daimler set out to liberate humanity from their dependence on the horse by harnessing the power of the internal combustion engine.
